import glob, os, re
from datetime import date, timedelta
from collections import Counter

ref = date(2025,8,12)
ranges = {
 'today': (ref, ref),
 'last_7_days': (ref-timedelta(days=6), ref),
 'last_30_days': (ref-timedelta(days=29), ref),
 'month_to_date': (ref.replace(day=1), ref),
}
sev = ['ERROR','WARNING','INFO']
counts = {k:{s:0 for s in sev} for k in list(ranges)+['total']}
pat = re.compile(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]')
for f in glob.glob('/app/logs/*.log'):
    fd = date.fromisoformat(os.path.basename(f)[:10])
    for line in open(f):
        m = pat.search(line)
        if not m: continue
        s = m.group(1)
        counts['total'][s]+=1
        for name,(a,b) in ranges.items():
            if a<=fd<=b:
                counts[name][s]+=1
with open('/app/summary.csv','w') as out:
    out.write('period,severity,count\n')
    for p in ['today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date','total']:
        for s in sev:
            out.write(f'{p},{s},{counts[p][s]}\n')
print(open('/app/summary.csv').read())
EOF
